artboards.title: 8 · Today, before there is a baseline

annotations.text:
STATIC SCREENS

The canvas preview does not run event handlers — tested four ways, all inert — so these are flat screens plus the map above rather than a tap-through.

Everything a prototype would have done is on the diagram, labelled with its trigger.

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

· Today leads with one sentence, not six equal numbers
· The 7-segment strip is valid_days / window_days — the error bar no competitor ships
· Screen 2 ends with what the metric CANNOT tell you
· Screen 4 attaches evidence to the answer
· On screen 5 the line breaks where the watch was off

THE HARDEST SCREEN

Week one has no baseline, so the app's whole idiom — "against your own preceding 28 days" — has nothing to say.

It shows single days and says so, rather than dressing one day up as a trend. The coverage strip is doing real work here: two of seven filled.

ALTERNATE AXIS — not a restyle

Data-forward instead of sentence-forward: six sparklines on one shared axis, light ground.

Tradeoff: faster for someone fluent in their own numbers, and it does none of the thinking for someone who is not.
